acceptanceCriteria: checkpoint_work_item's body is split into a private observation helper (reads summary.json, contract.json, and captures the git snapshot; returns a typed struct of gathered facts), a private governance-check helper (checkpoint's own state/duplicate/freshness/verification-ordering validation over the gathered facts, plus the existing unchanged call to require_green_or_yellow_preflight_governance), and the remaining persistence/receipt-construction code in checkpoint_work_item itself. The governance-check helper is not claimed to be I/O-free: require_green_or_yellow_preflight_governance still performs its own observation internally, unchanged from today; only checkpoint_work_item's own body is reorganized in this Work Item.
All 17 existing test files that call checkpoint_work_item pass unchanged, with no new test added or removed assertion, proving the split is behavior-identical.
cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test --locked --workspace pass.

The architecture-responsibility-map document (once WI-652 merges) should be updated to record this as the first proven P2-A use case; this Work Item's own doc states that follow-up explicitly since the map file does not exist on this branch yet.
goal: Split checkpoint_work_item's body into three internal, same-file helper functions matching Observation / Governance / Evidence+Projection boundaries, with zero change to the public function signature, error messages, field names, write order, or any observable behavior. This is a same-crate, same-file, no-new-public-API reorganization -- not a cross-module or cross-crate extraction -- chosen deliberately after WI-654 showed the safety cost of deeper changes to adjacent governance code.
intent: P2-A (extract lifecycle/storage/execution/projection responsibilities), first complete use case per the P0 map's recommendation to start with the smallest lifecycle function: checkpoint_work_item mixes observation (read summary/contract, capture git snapshot), governance decision (state/preflight-freshness/verification-ordering checks), and persistence (atomic_json write, LifecycleReceipt construction) inline in one function body. checkpoint_work_item already has test coverage across 17 test files in cockpit-repository/tests, giving a real regression net for a same-file, same-signature internal reorganization.
outOfScope: Any change to checkpoint_work_item's public signature
or the JSON fields it writes
or crate; this Work Item proves the responsibility boundary within the existing file first
higher-risk functions left for future Work Items only after this smallest case is proven
Introducing a trait/Port abstraction; none of the extracted helpers have more than one real implementation
